_description: Full-observability camera for HangProcCloth-v1. Front-angled view at 45 deg yaw, -25 deg pitch. Both the cloth hole and the hanger hook are clearly visible in frame.
_note: view_matrix is approximate; actual matrix computed by pybullet from cam_viewmat args. The cam_viewmat [dist,pitch,yaw,tx,ty,tz] = [9,-25,45,0,0.5,6.5] is the authoritative spec used in training scripts.
